where-were-participants-from: The process was facilitated by Deciding Matters, an independent team specialising in civic engagement and deliberation. Participants were recruited to reflect a mix of ages, backgrounds, and experiences from across Scotland. This cohort met in a series of online pre-sessions and then came together for a weekend event in Glasgow.
